themes: Humility and caring for every person
summary_for_children: 'Abasa reminds us to care for everyone who seeks guidance and asks us to look at our food: water, earth, grain, grapes, olives and fruit.
environment_concept: A walk that follows food from the start: a torrent of water pouring down rocks (80:25), earth split open by sprouts (80:26), rows of grain and grapevines on a trellis (80:27-28), olive and palm trees (80:29), and fruit trees over grass (80:31). The event of 80:1-10 and the Day of 80:33-42 are not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: A rocky waterfall and stream, cracked earth with sprouts, grain rows and a vine trellis, olive and palm trees, fruit trees.
